notes: 5 lb ABC hose-and-horn extinguisher with an aluminium valve; Amerex's parts lists print the model as A/B500 (and 500). Its ring pin number differs between Amerex's 2009 manual and its 2015 parts book, and the steel cylinder is stated only in seller listings.

gaps: Amerex's lists print this 5 lb ABC model as A/B500 and 500, not B500 alone; B500 is read as covered by A/B500 and is named only in seller listings.
Cylinder material: 'drawn steel' (Fire Supply Depot) and 'Steel' (Penn Tool) are seller listings only, so conf is likely; neither Amerex document names the shell material.
Valve material: Amerex's lists are headed aluminum valve models; Fire Supply Depot says anodized aluminum; Penn Tool says Metal.
Penn Tool's listing says Pressure Gauge: No, which conflicts with the 195 psi gauge in both Amerex documents; the Amerex lists are used.
Ring pin: part 01412 in the 2009 manual 05602 (printed page 8), part 00160 in the February 2015 parts book (printed page 3); not resolved.
Wall bracket: 01521 and 16591 are both listed for all 5 lb aluminum-valve models; Fire Supply Depot says 16591 is included with the B500.
Test pressure, cylinder volume and nameplate weight are not in the sources read.
Seller discharge time and range (14 s, 12 to 18 ft) are not Amerex figures and are not recorded.

Dry chemical and the nitrogen the manual uses to recharge are not recorded as components: no part type fits. Amerex's SDS for ABC dry chemical (CH550, F15, F18; model code 500; January 2015) gives monoammonium phosphate 55-75% and ammonium sulfate 20-40%.
Amerex calls the siphon tube a downtube (part 06212); siphon tube is this record's term.
Brackets: material is not stated in the sources, so the sheet_metal key is the record's category.
method: Amerex Owners Service Manual No. 05602 (form 0M05602B, rev. 04/09), copy on gczarnas.com: printed parts list page 8 (5 to 20 lb hose and horn, aluminum valve models).
Amerex Portable and Wheeled Parts Book (February 2015, SL-2000), copy on absupply.net: printed page 3 (5 to 20 lb hose and horn list) and page 28 (wall brackets).
Amerex SDS for ABC dry chemical (January 2015), copy on absupply.net: used for the composition line in the gaps only.
Fire Supply Depot and Penn Tool Co. listings: seller pages, cited for the cylinder and valve material and the gauge conflict only.

comps.spec: Valve assembly 11823 from the parts list for 5, 5½, 6 and 10 lb aluminium-valve hose-and-horn models, which names A/B500; lever 11825, handle 11826 (5 to 10 lb), valve stem assembly 06092, collar O-ring 05241 and spring 01074. The valve assembly includes the gauge
Steel cylinder (the listing says 'drawn steel') of the 5 lb ABC unit, 4.25 in diameter, from a retailer listing
Pressure gauge part 03103, listed as 195 psi, in the manual's list for 5 to 20 lb aluminium-valve hose-and-horn models (A/B500 among them); it comes as part of the valve assembly
Hose and horn assembly 06215, listed for A/B500; 05248 is listed for the 500, and the parts book says either fits the 500
Downtube and retainer assembly 06212 (the siphon tube), listed for A/B500 and 500
Ring pin: part 00160 in Amerex's 2015 parts book, but 01412 in its 2009 manual 05602; both list nylon chain 00532 and yellow lockwire seal 01387
Red wall hanger bracket 01521, listed for all 5 lb and 5½ lb aluminium-valve models; 16591 is also listed for those models
